Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.

revisionist. 
Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, Brief 
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to the respondent 
no. 2. 
Steps to be taken today itself. 
 Let counter affidavit be filed by 
the State by 07.10.2017. 
 List this matter on 09.10.2017. 
 Also heard on the stay 
application. 
 After considering the 
submission of the learned counsel 
for the parties and after going 
through the material available on 
record, it is directed that till the next 
date of listing parties shall maintain 
status quo over the property in 
dispute. 
 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 22.09.2017
